n.quote: Participants were randomly assigned to one of three groups: control (n = 15, mean age 23.07 years, 8 women), suppression (n = 16, mean age 22.50 years, 8 women), and reappraisal (n = 16, mean age 21.25 years, 7 women).

es.location: Results > Manipulation checks and mood, first paragraph
es.quote:
We examined responses to the two items to determine whether participants in the suppression group and reappraisal group attempted to regulate their emotions as instructed. One-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) reveal a significant effect of group, F(2, 44)  = 18.280, p<0.001, partial η
2
= 0.454. Pairwise comparisons showed that participants in the control group (2.800) reported less regulation than the suppression group (4.844, p<0.001) and reappraisal group (5.031, p<0.001), and the last two groups didn't differ (p = 0.642).

Pairwise comparisons showed that participants in the control group (2.800) reported less regulation than the suppression group (4.844, p<0.001) and reappraisal group (5.031, p<0.001), and the last two groups didn't differ (p = 0.642). ... notes: Identity verified independently from the supplied title, SOURCE URL and citation: Wang Y, Yang L, Wang Y (2014), PLoS ONE 9(4), e96339, DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0096339. Primary article HTML parse includes Methods, Results, Discussion and References; not abstract-only or secondary. Table 1 caption appears but table image cells are not transcribed. No PDF supplied. Only one experiment is described, with no separate Study 2 identifier; study_r=2 is not corroborated. The condition identifies a group, but does not identify a unique critical comparison. The source reports an omnibus three-group ANOVA plus pairwise comparisons, rather than separate within-condition manipulation effects. Target-test correspondence is unresolved. Printed candidates: omnibus F(2, 44) = 18.280, p<0.001, partial eta squared = 0.454; control/suppression p<0.001; control/reappraisal p<0.001; suppression/reappraisal p=0.642. Means are control 2.800, suppression 4.844, reappraisal 5.031. No pairwise effect sizes are printed in this paragraph. No conversion from partial eta squared to eta squared is made. Candidate final group counts: control 15, suppression 16, reappraisal 16 participants. Explicit mutually exclusive groups permit candidate common-model N: 15 + 16 + 16 = 47; control/suppression: 15 + 16 = 31; control/reappraisal: 15 + 16 = 31; suppression/reappraisal: 16 + 16 = 32. These remain candidates pending target-test identification, not extracted analytic N. No N inferred from df. Eleven participants excluded: 4 excessive incongruent Stroop errors, 4 excessive EEG artifacts, 3 fewer than six error trials after artifact rejection. The manipulation-check narrative describes instruction compliance, but no condition-specific replication-success verdict relative to the original is identified. The Discussion replication claim concerns ERN, a different outcome. Unassigned original side and unassigned replication fields are placeholders only.
